title: Whitechapel Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency hospitals, urgent treatment centres, and local support points for Whitechapel.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 first.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E and Major Trauma Centre:
- The Royal London Hospital, Whitechapel Road, London E1 1FR. This is a designated Major Trauma Centre offering full 24-hour emergency care. Approximate travel: from Whitechapel Station, it is a direct 2-minute walk (~150 metres) south across Whitechapel Road. From Aldgate East Station, walk ~8 minutes east along Whitechapel High Street/Whitechapel Road (~0.4 miles) or take bus 25 or 205.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres:
- The Royal London Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre, Ground Floor, Whitechapel Road, London E1 1FR. Located on the main hospital site for non-life-threatening urgent injuries and illnesses.
- Barkantine Urgent Treatment Centre, 121 Westferry Road, Isle of Dogs, London E14 8JH. From Stepney Green Station, take bus 277 or D3 heading south (~20 minutes travel).

3. Local Hazard Notes:
- Whitechapel sits on low-lying land north of the Thames. While protected from tidal flooding, low points along Whitechapel Road, Commercial Road, and Cambridge Heath Road are vulnerable to surface water flooding during heavy cloudbursts. Subterranean rail links at Whitechapel and Shadwell may suffer water ingress in extreme storms.

4. Essential Supplies:
- Pharmacies and large supermarkets along Whitechapel Road, Commercial Road, and Mile End Road can supply bottled water, basic first-aid items, and over-the-counter medicines during local outages.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
